virtual_associations.name: 关联客户主表
virtual_associations.description: 多条联系方式记录可属于同一客户

business_constraints.deleted: 查询时需加 deleted = 0 过滤已删除数据
business_constraints.usage_pattern: 通常在查询customer_info时通过EXISTS子查询条件按联系方式类型过滤，例如：EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_contact cc WHERE cc.customer_code = main.code AND cc.deleted = 0 AND cc.concat_type = 1 AND cc.concat = 'xxx')。也用于Java层批量查询后脱敏展示

business_rules.description: 手机号(concat_type=0)和微信号(concat_type=1)在Java层会进行脱敏/加密处理后再返回前端
